youtube.title: Your Leads Are Slipping Through? Here's the 10-Minute n8n Fix
youtube.description:
Most small businesses don't have a lead problem, they have a leak. Someone fills in the contact form on a Tuesday night, the notification lands in an inbox nobody checks until Thursday, and by then they've heard back from someone else.

This video builds one n8n workflow, in about ten minutes once your accounts are connected, that plugs the three places leads slip through: nobody sees it, nobody replies fast, nobody follows up. Plus the fourth leak nobody plans for: the fix itself breaking quietly.

The workflow, step by step:
1. Catch the form: a Webhook node (or n8n's Form Trigger), and why your form needs the production URL, not the test one.
2. Write it down: tidy the data with Edit Fields and append or update a Google Sheets row matched on email, with a status column.
3. Reply in a minute: a short, honest automatic reply from your real address.
4. Tell a human: an alert to Slack, Telegram or your phone with a link to the row.
5. The next-day check: a Wait node and an If node that remind you, not the lead, when nobody has replied.
Then an Error Trigger workflow so you find out when it breaks, the Google sign-in that expires after seven days, and a thirty-second weekly test.
